trials.claimQuote:
Lifetime access to Notte
- All future Developer Plan updates

trials.reasoning: Buyers in E8 and E9 confirm the purchase provides a lifetime deal, and E1 about monthly credit refreshes does not show lifetime access ending.

exhibits.quote: Subscription credits refresh monthly and expire each cycle.
exhibits.argument: Lifetime access is undermined because official plan credits refresh monthly and expire each cycle rather than persisting.

exhibits.quote: The lifetime deal allows you to run browsers completely free if you don't use proxies.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms a lifetime deal exists that covers browser usage.

exhibits.quote: The lifetime deal is the big win here. Offers like this are rare.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms the purchase was sold as a lifetime deal.

trials.claim: Tier 1 includes 100 browser hours per month, 0 bonus hours, and 25 concurrency
trials.claimQuote:
- 100 Browser hours per month
- 0 Bonus browser hours (one-time)
- 25 Browser concurrency
trials.reasoning: E2 shows credits are shared across sessions, functions, proxies and LLM tokens rather than dedicated browser hours, and E3 reports exhausting the tier on two simple functions; E10 supports only the 25 concurrency part.

exhibits.quote: Plans grant credits and operational limits. Credits are spent on browser sessions, functions, proxies, and LLM tokens at transparent usage rates.
exhibits.argument: The 100 browser hours claim is undermined because official credits are shared across sessions, functions, proxies and LLM tokens, not dedicated browser hours.

exhibits.quote: Just to build two simple functions (a login and filling out a form) I burned through the entire tier subscription, and on top of that it couldn't even run them because it didn't build them right.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports burning through the entire tier subscription building two simple functions, contradicting usable 100 hours per month.

exhibits.quote:
Browser concurrency- 25

Agents / functions- 25 concurrent

Session duration- 120 min
exhibits.argument: Vendor's official pricing lists 25 browser concurrency for the Developer plan.

exhibits.quote: Plans grant credits and operational limits. Credits are spent on browser sessions, functions, proxies, and LLM tokens at transparent usage rates.

exhibits.argument: Buyer spent about half of monthly credits in a few hours of use, contradicting that 100 monthly plus 8000 bonus hours provides large capacity.
